summary: The WP1 fleet was a Hawker Siddeley HS125-700 and, from 1994, Gulfstream G-1159B serial 151; N908JE migrated from the Hawker to the Gulfstream, while the Boeing 727 and N120JE are out of period.
detail: The Rodgers log first names Epstein and Maxwell on HS125-700 N404CB on 1991-07-26 and clearly records the Hawker as N908JE by 1991-10-23. A historical FAA file says the existing N908JE Hawker, serial NA-0262, was to become N988JE after Hyperion Air purchased Gulfstream G-1159B serial 151, formerly N979GA. A released aircraft-history sheet dates Hyperion Air's entry to 1994-02-19; FAA number-change authority dated 1994-04-20 assigned N908JE to the Gulfstream. The 1994 log pages then show the Hawker as N988JE and the Gulfstream as N908JE. Released FAA chronology places the Boeing's acquisition/tail migration in 2001 and N120JE in 2017.

summary: Rodgers' 1991-94 log produces no Oslo/Fornebu, London, Tunis, Stockholm, or other target European/MENA hit in any channel or side-trip window; Rule 1 is not triggered.
detail: Across 17 core windows, the log records 39 legs in 12 windows: 37 domestic and two Canada-crossing legs, with Epstein explicitly named on 34 rows in the structured passenger transcription. Across the full 28-row chronology matrix, there are zero target European/MENA legs. Five core windows are log gaps rather than affirmative location evidence. This is a bounded Rodgers-instrument null and is not generalized to Visoski, charter, commercial travel, or H3.

summary: During the 1993-09-07/11 final Paris window, the Rodgers log records six North American legs and no Paris or Fornebu leg; Epstein is explicitly named on four rows, including Columbus-Montreal.
detail: The page records 1993-09-07 Teterboro-Columbus, 1993-09-08 Columbus-Teterboro, and on 1993-09-10 Teterboro-Columbus-Montreal (CYMX)-Rochester-Columbus. The structured passenger transcription names Epstein on the first four route rows, through Columbus-Montreal; the Montreal-Rochester and Rochester-Columbus return rows have no parsed passenger name and are not asserted as his personal movement. The page contains no Paris, London, Oslo, or MENA field.
